set.body: The owner decision on S2.8 says a fixed appearance preference seeds new projects while opened projects keep their document theme. AppearancePreference.newProjectTheme implements the pure policy, but ProjectLifecycleHost still builds every fresh untitled/new document with AppModel.newProject defaults. Inject the desired fresh-project theme through the lifecycle host, snapshot it on FX before asynchronous creation, wire StudioMain to the existing policy, and verify fresh/closed/new projects honor Dark without edits or undo while opening a saved Light project preserves Light. This is a follow-up to the current frozen daily-use candidate; do not edit its checkout.
set.title: Native new projects: honor the fixed appearance preference
